class.name: AudioStreamAWB
class.brief_description: Audio stream resource loaded directly from an AWB file.
class.description: AWB files are loaded as this resource type. Uses vgmstream to decode the selected subsong at runtime. Subsong indices are 1-based; the default is 1.

members.member: AWB file resource to play. Leave empty when using an .awb file directly; assign it when saving a subsong selection in a separate AudioStreamAWB resource.
1-based index of the AWB subsong to play. The resource loader does not enumerate subsongs, so an invalid index is reported when playback starts.
